## 🚀 Featured Production Projects

### 1. Suraksha Setu (AI Tourist Safety Platform)
- **Category:** Full-Stack MERN + AI Security Ecosystem
- **Description:** Real-time tourist safety and emergency SOS platform featuring live safe-route guidance, QR-based digital tourist IDs, and an automated police & emergency contacts notification system.

### 2. Swasthya Setu (Comprehensive Healthcare Platform)
- **Category:** Full-Stack MERN + Healthcare AI Hub
- **Description:** Smart healthcare application providing instant first aid guidance, real-time blood bank inventory locator, online doctor consultations, and Sayraa AI health assistant.
- **Tech Stack:** React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Sayraa AI Chatbot.
- **Live Demo:** https://frontend-five-khaki-22.vercel.app
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/subham-khandual/swasthya-setu

### 3. Sayraa AI PPT Generator
- **Category:** AI Presentation Platform
- **Description:** Automated AI tool that converts topic prompts into fully formatted, structured PowerPoint presentations with speaker notes using Gemini and Groq LLMs.
- **Tech Stack:** Python, Flask, Gemini LLM, Groq Cloud, Bootstrap.
- **Live Demo:** https://ppt-generator-seven-mu.vercel.app
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/subham-khandual/ppt-generator

### 4. Sayraa AI Health Care Assistant
- **Category:** Multilingual Voice AI Companion
- **Description:** Voice-enabled health companion offering medical guidance in Odia, Hindi, and English with offline PWA support and Web Speech API.
- **Tech Stack:** React.js, Groq LLM, Web Speech API, Firebase, PWA, Tailwind CSS.
- **Live Demo:** https://sayraa-health-care-ai-assistant.vercel.app
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/subham-khandual/sayraa-health-care-ai-assistant

### 5. Envistream Eduskill Chatbot
- **Category:** Educational Conversational AI
- **Description:** Interactive education chatbot providing instant study Q&A, academic resource curation, and student guidance.
- **Tech Stack:** React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JavaScript.
